baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future second-person remembering verb governs the content of the speaker's present saying.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded utterance is delivered now and cognitively returns later. The future form makes the saying effective across a delay rather than exhausted at delivery.

activation_trace.role: Recollection after forgetting supplies delayed mental re-presence, making the future verb recover the present utterance.
Articulated speech supplies a bounded verbal object that can later return to awareness.

changed_reading.before: The speaker predicts that his audience will later recall a warning.
changed_reading.after: The speaker plants an utterance whose efficacy lies in its delayed re-presence after present resistance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The saying is completed before the speaker delegates his affair to God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker retains responsibility for utterance but releases control of his case and outcome. Delegation follows testimony; it does not replace it.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech supplies the speaker's completed public act before control is released.
Returning an affair to another in reliance supplies transfer of control to God after the speaker acts.
Affair as situation or case supplies the transferred domain: the speaker's condition and outcome, not his duty to speak.

changed_reading.before: The speaker warns his hearers and then expresses private trust.
changed_reading.after: He performs accountable speech and then deliberately relinquishes ownership of what happens to his case.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal assertion that God sees the servants grounds the delegation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Delegation is rational because the receiving authority has both outward sight and inward discernment over every servant involved. The speaker does not ask for partisan blindness; he submits all parties, including himself, to comprehensive sight.

activation_trace.role: Reliant transfer supplies the movement of the case into another's jurisdiction.
Direct sight supplies unobstructed observation of the parties and their acts.
Inward insight supplies knowledge beyond visible conduct, grounding confidence in a fully informed receiver.
Submissive service places speaker and opponents within one accountable field under God.

changed_reading.before: God's sight reassures the threatened speaker.
changed_reading.after: God's comprehensive sight establishes the jurisdiction to which the entire human conflict is submitted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembering is paired with turning back, while concealed interiors are placed before decisive judgment in truth by the seeing God. The future recollection in the focus therefore becomes moral reorientation under disclosed judgment, not neutral retrieval.

activation_trace.role: Recovered awareness supplies the act that only a responsive hearer performs, sharpening the focus future into consequential recognition.
Habitual return supplies a directional movement toward God, giving recollection a reorienting function.
Concealment supplies the hidden inward material that divine sight must reach.
Decisive judgment supplies the authoritative act that distinguishes God's seeing from powerless observation.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the norm by which the delegated case is decided.
Penetrating insight supplies informed judgment and links the contextual divine attribute back to the focus ground for delegation.

structural_cues: 40:13 pairs remembering with the person who turns back.
40:16-20 moves from nothing being hidden through recompense and concealed interiors to judgment in truth by the hearing, seeing God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recollection, return, concealment, truth, judgment, and sight; I infer a movement from recovered awareness to accountable reorientation. A live alternative is that these are parallel exhortations without a single judicial sequence.

changed_reading.before: The audience will mentally recall the speaker's words.
changed_reading.after: The audience will recover the words as recognition that turns a formerly hidden moral posture toward disclosed judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed insider breaks cover under a lethal threat, while the ruler claims control of what others may see and calls his own path right. The focus saying becomes a risky counter-witness whose warrant is divine insight rather than sovereign display.

activation_trace.role: Hiding and covering supplies the speaker's prior protected state, making his subsequent utterance an exposure.
Taking life supplies the concrete coercive risk against which the counter-witness speaks.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the ruler's claimed epistemic monopoly, which divine insight in the focus contests.
Compelling proof supplies the absent warrant of the disputants, separating loud authority from grounded knowledge.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies the believer's counter-mode of leadership.
A straight path away from error supplies the destination proposed by the speaker's words.
Inward discernment supplies the superior epistemic ground under which the exposed speaker places his case.

structural_cues: 40:28 identifies the speaker as a believer who had concealed his faith and now speaks inside a killing debate.
40:29 gives the ruler a repeated claim to showing and seeing; 40:36-37 turns that claim into an attempted visual ascent, while 40:38 returns to guided direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, lethal exposure, rival claims to sight, missing proof, and competing guidance; I infer that the focus utterance is counter-witness against a regime of controlled visibility. A live alternative is that the ruler's sight language and the focus divine sight are only adjacent motifs.

changed_reading.before: A believer offers a warning and trusts God.
changed_reading.after: A concealed insider publicly contests sovereign control of truth, then entrusts the exposed witness to the One whose sight penetrates beyond display.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, opposed parties repeatedly call one another toward incompatible destinations, and the speaker declares the common return to God. His final saying closes a failed reciprocal forum; delegation transfers the affair out of that deadlocked exchange.

activation_trace.role: Calling as verbal attraction supplies the two opposed pulls that structure the failed exchange.
Repeated verbal calling supplies reciprocal persuasion toward incompatible objects.
The call and the denied answering call supply the collapse of reciprocity in the human forum.
Return to a destination supplies the higher endpoint toward which the unresolved affair moves.
Mutual handling of an affair through speech supplies the conversational forum whose limits have now been reached.
Interaction among interlocutors over an affair supplies the failed horizontal process from which the speaker exits.
Reliant transfer supplies the vertical relocation of the deadlocked affair to God.

structural_cues: 40:41-42 forms a call and counter-call sequence toward rescue and fire.
40:43 denies efficacy to the rival call, names return to God, and is followed directly by the focus saying and delegation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal calls, their incompatibility, return to God, and then delegation; I infer a forum exit from failed persuasion to divine disposition. A live alternative is that delegation is devotional closure rather than a transfer between forums.

changed_reading.before: The focus combines one final warning with trust.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the speaker's last move in a deadlocked exchange: he leaves the saying with his hearers and moves the unresolved affair to God's forum.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct sequel places protection after public exposure and makes harmful consequence surround the opposing house. Delegation is therefore compatible with costly speech and is followed by a reversal of where danger lands.

activation_trace.role: Reliant transfer supplies the act immediately preceding the protective outcome.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the concrete preservation of the exposed speaker.
What causes harm supplies both the threat avoided by the speaker and the consequence reaching his opponents.
Descending harm that surrounds its target supplies the reversal by which danger closes around the plotters.

structural_cues: 40:45 begins as the immediate consequence of 40:44 and states that God protected the speaker.
The same ayah contrasts harms avoided by the speaker with harmful punishment enclosing Pharaoh's house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct adjacency, protection, harmful acts, and enclosing consequence; I infer delegation followed by protective reversal. A live alternative is temporal succession without a claim that delegation caused the protection.

changed_reading.before: Delegation is inward resignation in the face of danger.
changed_reading.after: Delegation follows exposed testimony and relocates danger: the witness is shielded while the intended harm surrounds its makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later disputation and pleas are answered by recalling prior messengers and disclosed meaning, after which excuses do not benefit. The remembered saying therefore functions as prior notice in an evidentiary exchange, not merely as private regret.

activation_trace.role: A prevailing argument supplies the post-judgment forum in which earlier speech becomes relevant evidence.
Repeated articulated answers supply the verbal reconstruction of what warning had already occurred.
Messenger and message supply the authorized prior communication recalled in the later exchange.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies the clarity that makes later denial answerable.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the failed practical value of belated defense.
Excuse supplies the defensive speech that prior warning renders ineffective.

structural_cues: 40:47-50 stages argument and petition after judgment, then answers by recalling that messengers had already come with disclosures.
40:51-52 moves to witnesses standing and excuses failing to benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies later argument, recalled messengers, disclosure, and useless excuses; I infer that the focus saying becomes prior notice with evidentiary force. A live alternative is that the later dialogue recalls prophecy generally rather than this speaker's words specifically.

changed_reading.before: The hearers will regret having ignored the saying.
changed_reading.after: They will encounter the saying again as prior notice that answers their later plea and removes the usefulness of excuse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Support and public witness are promised, yet the instructed posture is patience and refuge, and the speaker may die before seeing the promised outcome. Delegation becomes disciplined action without possession of timetable or spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Aid that also makes a cause manifest supplies the promised public vindication of faithful speech.
Presence with observation supplies a later public scene where truth is witnessed rather than privately hoped.
Restraint from panic supplies the active posture required during deferred fulfillment.
A spoken promise that opens hope supplies confidence without present control of completion.
Seeking shelter supplies continuing dependence while dispute persists.
A promise bounded by an eventual appointment supplies a schedule held outside the witness's control.
Taking the soul supplies the possibility that the witness's life ends before visible completion.
Return to the prior source supplies the invariant endpoint whether or not the speaker sees the intermediate result.
Reliant transfer supplies the focus act that permits continued duty without ownership of timing.

structural_cues: 40:51 promises support in present life and when witnesses stand; 40:55 commands patience because the promise is true.
40:56 repeats refuge before divine hearing and sight, while 40:77 explicitly leaves open whether the addressee sees the outcome or dies first.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, witness, patience, refuge, promise, possible death, and universal return; I infer that delegation separates faithful action from control of timing. A live alternative is that these passages console different addressees without defining the focus delegation.

changed_reading.before: The speaker hands over his affair because he cannot control it.
changed_reading.after: He accepts a disciplined nonpossession of outcome: speak, persist, seek refuge, and let fulfillment occur even beyond his own sight or lifetime.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remembrance is presented as guidance for discerning minds and then placed beside the blind-seeing polarity and scarce remembering. The focus future becomes eventual moral sight: the hearers will not merely retrieve words but perceive what they failed to see in them.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward truth supplies the practical orientation produced by remembrance.
A reminder that restores presence supplies an external means by which guidance remains available.
Blindness of inward perception supplies the failure that present nonrecognition embodies.
Insight of the heart supplies the positive perceptual state into which future remembering may change.
Littleness supplies the stated scarcity of this morally perceptive remembering.
Recovered awareness supplies the local counterpart to the focus prediction and binds recollection to the sight contrast.

structural_cues: 40:54 coordinates guidance and reminder for people of understanding.
40:58 contrasts blindness and sight, moral action, and the small degree of remembering in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance-reminder coordination and a blind-seeing contrast ending in scarce recollection; I infer that remembering functions as recovered moral vision. A live alternative is that sight and recollection are separate comparisons joined only rhetorically.

changed_reading.before: The audience will remember the semantic content of the warning.
changed_reading.after: The audience will finally see through the warning, recovering the moral perception that was absent when it was spoken.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command to speak and submit is followed by God's deciding an affair and saying it into occurrence. This creates an asymmetry: the human saying bears witness and delegates, while divine saying enacts the affair.

activation_trace.role: Commanded voiced speech supplies the human duty to articulate a position publicly.
Submissive worship supplies the human relation within which commanded speech occurs.
Binding command supplies the obligation that governs the human speaker.
Perfecting and executing an act supplies the divine completion of an affair.
Affair as case supplies the same domain delegated in the focus, now under divine decision.
Uttered saying supplies the divine speech-act that follows decision.
Occurrence and presence in time supply the realized effect of divine saying.

structural_cues: 40:66 joins a command to speak with commands concerning worship and submission.
40:68 joins divine decision over an affair to divine saying and immediate occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated saying and affair roots under human command and divine execution; I infer an asymmetry from human testimony to divine enactment. A live alternative is that the repeated roots reinforce sovereignty without assigning distinct functions to the two speakers.

changed_reading.before: The believer says what he can and asks God to manage the rest.
changed_reading.after: Human speech performs testimony but cannot produce the outcome; it delegates the affair to the divine Speaker whose saying brings the decided matter into occurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah forecasts that deniers will know, then closes with seeing overwhelming force, verbally professing belief, and finding that belief useless within a long-running pattern. The focus future remembering therefore carries a deadline: recognition can become accurate only after its capacity to redirect action has expired.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the forecasted future cognition that parallels the focus future remembering.
Sight by eye or insight supplies the late evidentiary threshold at which denial collapses.
Overwhelming force supplies the event that compels recognition.
Articulated profession supplies the audience's belated verbal response once sight is unavoidable.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the practical efficacy that late belief no longer has.
Compelled sight supplies the point at which cognition becomes certain but untimely.
Overwhelming force supplies the irreversible setting of that recognition.
A continuing way or established course supplies the repeated pattern behind the closing outcome.
Past generations passing away supplies the historical depth of the pattern.

structural_cues: 40:70 forecasts future knowledge after denial of the book and messengers.
40:84-85 sequences seeing force, saying belief, and the explicit nonbenefit of belief at that point within an established historical pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forecasted knowledge, compelled sight, verbal belief, nonbenefit, and an established past pattern; I infer a deadline after which correct recognition cannot repair prior refusal. A live alternative is that the focus remembering predicts regret without specifying salvific or practical timing.

changed_reading.before: Future recollection vindicates the speaker because his opponents will know he was right.
changed_reading.after: Future recollection is a warning about epistemic lateness: they may know and say the right thing only when recognition can no longer change their course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a rights-document branch of the remembering root is applied to a future verb of recollection. It remains anchored through that focus root and is activated by contextual writing, fixed right, and witness imagery. Downstream prose should present it only as a juridical functional analogy, not as the lexical meaning of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The remembering root can carry a documentary right-image, while the focus makes the speaker's saying the object retained for later recovery.

activation_trace.role: A document preserving a right supplies the exploratory image of the saying as a deposited claim.
Written establishment that obligates a ruling supplies durability and normative force for the record analogy.
A fixed right belonging to its holder supplies the claim preserved by the remembered utterance.
A witnessing tongue supplies the later evidentiary use of speech as if the utterance were produced from a record.

changed_reading.before: The saying remains in subjective memory.
changed_reading.after: The saying is exploratorily carried as a deposited rights-record that can be produced when witness and judgment arrive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant split mapping from the saying root to the littleness root. It remains anchored because 40:58 directly places littleness and remembering together, reactivating both focus roots. Downstream prose must describe a contextual resonance, not claim that the focus saying lexically means something little.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus binds what the speaker says to future remembering, and its split inventory includes a form-distant littleness branch.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant littleness branch supplies exploratory pressure to read the saying as presently minimized by its hearers.
Recovered awareness supplies the later return of what was minimized at delivery.
Explicit littleness supplies the whole-surah activator for the focus root's split target.
The local remembering verb binds littleness to recollection and returns that relation to the focus prediction.

changed_reading.before: They will remember the content of a saying they rejected.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they will recover precisely the saying they had made little of when it was spoken.

strongest_changes: Future remembering became moral recognition under judgment and, at the close, recognition that can arrive too late to benefit.
Delegation became testimony before release: the speaker acts publicly without claiming control of outcome or timing.
The immediate call-and-countercall and protection sequence turned the focus into an exit from a failed forum followed by protective reversal.
The repeated saying and affair roots distinguished human witness-bearing speech from divine speech that enacts the decided affair.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet places the focus at a hinge: reciprocal calls collapse immediately before it, protection follows immediately after it, and later root recurrences develop witness, deferred promise, divine enactment, and useless late recognition.
remaining_uncertainties: The adjacency of delegation and protection strongly supports sequence, but causation remains reader-supplied.
The prior-notice and rights-record models may over-juridicize language that can remain broadly admonitory.
The saying-to-littleness split activation is deliberately form-distant and should remain exploratory.
Divine sight may ground reassurance and knowledge without requiring the full jurisdictional model.
